# FLOP Session Router

Purpose: deterministic off-chain FLOP-oriented routing, eligibility, bounded preflight, failover and auditable replay.

Agent entrypoint: AGENTS.md
Safety and limitations: README.md and SECURITY.md
API contract: openapi.json
Protocol compatibility pins: protocol-compat.json

Adjacent evidence verifier: https://github.com/retardio73-boop/flop-conformance-lab
Adjacent operator dashboard: https://github.com/retardio73-boop/flop-control-center

Fail closed when authoritative live runtime evidence is unavailable or quote units are incomparable.
